declaredDeviations.reason: guard serves /health from its own handler in services/guard/src/app/main.cc ({"status":"ok","service":"argus-guard"}) and never registers the shared HealthController, so the body is not the envelope; the compose healthcheck for guard polls the status code only (curl -kfs), and every other unit answers the shared envelope

invariants: no probe may answer 5xx except the camera-control 502, which must carry CAMERA_UNREACHABLE
a probe with no token must answer 401, and so must a probe whose token belongs to another device
a malformed JSON body on a ValidJsonFilter route must answer 400
a multipart body must never be answered 400
a JSON answer must carry exactly the {status, info, errors} envelope
a 204 answer must carry an empty body

normalization.maskedHex32: any 32-character lowercase hexadecimal value (a session id)
normalization.maskedShape: a masked key keeps the shape of what it held, so an object under it is still compared field by field
normalization.maskedTokens: any value shaped like a three-part JWT

volatileFields.reason: a camera's health is the stream supervisor's last observation, unknown until its first probe and unreachable after it for the fixture camera; the rest of each row stays pinned
the push channel's self-test runs on its own schedule, so these fields report the last probe's outcome rather than a contract; the counters beside them stay pinned
the recommendation is derived from the cores, RAM, ISA and GPU of the host that answers, so it differs between machines; the profile previews beside it stay pinned
a heartbeat stamps the second it answers and the presence change it reports, so both move on every call; the interval, grace and armed state beside them stay pinned
